question: How do published Lan Luan lab recording and decoding values compare with SONIC?
scope: Published platforms coauthored by Rice's Lan Luan. These sources do not identify Howard's installed or available recorder/probe, or establish a Rice auditory ITR.

sonic.task: 10 ms pure-tone sequences in two selected awake, alert sheep; intracortical A1 recording and held-out decoding
sonic.note: Achieved ITR is conditional on stimuli, recording site, processing and decoder. It is not raw digital streaming throughput.

luan_coauthored_platforms.citation: Zhao et al. Ultraflexible electrode arrays for months-long high-density electrophysiological mapping of thousands of neurons in rodents. Nature Biomedical Engineering 7, 520-532 (2023).
luan_coauthored_platforms.locators: Author manuscript printed pp.3-4: channel counts; p.6/Fig.4: visual decoding; p.12: acquisition; pp.13-14: visual stimuli and decoding. The repository PDF adds one cover page.
luan_coauthored_platforms.limits: Maximum platform channels are not the channel count in every demonstration. Sorted units are not equivalent to electrode contacts and include single and multi units. Visual angular error cannot be ranked against SONIC tone accuracy or bits/s.

luan_coauthored_platforms.citation: Fan et al. High-channel-count neural recording and stimulation platform with 5376 simultaneous recording channels. npj Biomedical Innovations 3, 46 (2026).
luan_coauthored_platforms.locators: Results: ASIC architecture and electrical benchmarks/Fig.2; Fig.4h; In vivo cortical mapping/Fig.5; Discussion; Methods: ASIC design and Brain mapping experiments
luan_coauthored_platforms.animal_demonstration: Acute rat cortical surface micro-ECoG; mechanically evoked whisker, limb and trunk response maps
luan_coauthored_platforms.limits: Demonstration records population field potentials, not the same signal modality as SONIC intracortical spike-band features. Four of 84 ASIC columns are configured as electrical reference banks, and reported impedance yield is 92%; supported acquisition slots do not equal independently validated tissue contacts. Single-unit validation and in vivo electrical stimulation are future work.

derived_hardware_comparison.interpretation: These are arithmetic comparisons of acquisition specifications, not predictions of recovered sensory information or ITR superiority.

conclusion: No directly comparable SONIC-style auditory ITR was located in the relevant published work checked. This does not establish absence of unpublished lab results. More channels and faster sampling alone cannot predict whether a Rice experiment would exceed 201.9 or 230.1 bits/s.
professor_question: Have we measured held-out tone decoding and bias-corrected bits/s on our system, or do we currently have recording and evoked-response validation only?
verification: Primary publisher text and public author manuscript checked; numerical comparison independently calculated; independent source review agreed. No website, review PDF, older preparation record, neighboring project or source manuscript changed.

user_clarification.evidence: Howard selected penetrating NET threads in this chat; exact revision and implant configuration remain unspecified.

sonic_connexus.geometry: Solid platinum-iridium penetrating pins, Parylene-C insulated with deinsulated recording tips
sonic_connexus.limits: Nominal pin length is not verified insertion depth. Exposed tip area and quantitative stiffness are absent. Anatomical A1 coverage estimates are not functional channel yield.

published_net_type_I.reference: Zhao et al.,2023 issue; public author manuscript Results p3 and Methods pp10-11
published_net_type_I.role: Representative published lab NET design, not a verified specification for Howard's exact probe
published_net_type_I.insertion: Temporary 25um-diameter tungsten shuttles, removed after implantation
published_net_type_I.limits: Contact square edge length is not a diameter; shank thickness is not cylindrical diameter; vertical-plane coverage is not physical shank length. Shank/module spacing and along-depth contact spacing are distinct axes. More contacts, closer placement and flexibility do not by themselves establish higher auditory ITR.

probe_comparison.interpretation: Both are penetrating extracellular recording technologies. NET sites run along a flexible shank and allow depth-distributed sampling; Connexus records at the exposed tips of an array of metal pins. Published NET rodent studies support months-long recording stability, but no head-to-head Connexus comparison or Rice SONIC result is established. The 5376-channel surface micro-ECoG demonstration is a separate probe modality and is not Howard's selected penetrating NET family.
